quote: Allow Energy Storage Facilities as a Special Use and to Develop Standards and Definitions for Energy Storage Facilites

incorporated_in.reason: Article 3 Sec. 3-320 row 1.a lists Battery Energy Storage System, Tier 2 with SE in RA, BP, I-1 and I-2, the use and districts this amendment adds, so the cited Article 3 text already carries the amendment.

notes: Already applied in the cached ordinance text: Article 3 Sec. 3-320 row 1.a 'Battery Energy Storage System, Tier 2' shows SE in RA, BP, I-1 and I-2, and Article 5 Sec. 5-2004 and the Article 15 definition carry the standards. The districts are read from that row. The other bundled amendments in 2024-11 to 2026-07 touch none of the seven use classes; the 2026-07-09 Sec. 4-605 item adds accessory storage in the PCID, which is not warehouse_distribution.
